The lower half features a medium close-up of a young woman with brown hair and bangs, wearing a blue denim button-down shirt and white wired earphones. She smiles broadly and laughs while looking slightly off-camera. A banner with the name 'Xiao Kui' and social media icons is fixed at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to a primary full-screen view of the mobile game's battlefield. The environment is a vibrant fantasy setting with stone pathways, green grass, and defense towers. A white-clad character moves through the lane, surrounded by glowing blue and red indicators, health bars, and numeric damage markers. The female creator's live reaction continues in a small circular inset at the top right, showing her expressive facial movements and mouth gestures as she talks and reacts to the game events. (3) The final segment returns to a focused view of the creator. She is shown laughing heartily with her head tilted back, her eyes squinted in amusement. A meme graphic of a man with his arms raised in a similar joyful expression is briefly overlaid on the left. The background is a dimly lit room with a portion of a gaming chair visible. Yellow subtitles with black outlines appear centered at the bottom of the frame throughout the sequence.
